lomasaṃ dharmatatvajñaṃ paryapṛ
cha yudhiṣṭiraḥ ||
yo rakṣat prāṇinaṃ brahman_ bhayārttaṃ śaraṇāgataṃ ||

tasya puṇyaphalaṃ ya¦
t syāt_ tan me brūhi mahāmune ||
ekataḥ kratavaḥ sarve samagravaradakṣiṇāḥ ||

ekato bhayabhītasya
prāṇina prāṇarakṣaṇaṃ ||
idamaiva purā devāḥ tulayā samatolayan ||
prāṇirakṣaṇam eveha gauraveṇātiricyate
atraivodāharaṃtīmam itihāsaṃ purātanaṃ ||
idrasyāgneś ca saṃvādaṃ śisavariver auśīnarasya ca ||

varttamāne mahā
yajñe jijñāsārthaṃ śivaṃ nṛpaṃ ||
idrasyena kapoto gni bhūtvā tatropajagmatuḥ ||

athāṃkaṃ nṛpateḥ prāpya ka
potaḥ syenajād bhayāt ||
śaraṇārthī mahīpālaṃ nilibye bhayavihvalaḥ ||

tataḥ śenair upāgaṃmya śyenarūpī sure
śvaruṃ ||
rājāniṃ sa mahātmānaṃ provācedeṃ vacas tadā ||

dharmātmānaṃ tvām ihāhur ekaṃ rājan mahī
kṣitaṃ ||
sa tvaṃ dharmaviruddhaṃ hi kathaṃ karma cikīrṣasi ||
bhavān kṛtaghnaṃ dānena satto nānṛvādinaṃ ||

kṣamayā
krūrakarmāṇam asāyuṃ sādhunā jayet ||
nopakārāpareṣv evam upakāraparo janaḥ ||

nāpakāraparokṣe yam u
pakaraparo yathā ||
ahite hitabuddhis tvaṃ pāpe pi tvam apāpakṛt ||

doṣo nveṣaṇadakṣe pi guṇānveṣaṇa
tatparaḥ ||
tad ekavihite bhakṣaḥ pīḍyamānasya me kṣudhā ||
mā hiṃse lobhato dharmam enam utsṛja bhūyate ||
saṃtrastā rūpas trāṇārthī tvatto bhīto vihaṃgame ||
matsakāśam anuprāptaḥ prāṇa gṛhyarayaṃ khagaḥ ||

tad eva
m āgatasyāsya kapotasyābhayattakaḥ ||
kathaṃm asmadvidhe kuryāt tyāgaṃ sadbhir vigarhitaṃ ||

lobhād veṣād bhayād vāpi yastya
jecharaṇāgataṃ ||
brahmahatyāsamaṃ tasyaṃ papam āhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||

śāstreṣu niṣkatir dṛṣṭā mahāpātakinām a
pi ||
śaraṇāgatāhaṃtṛṇāṃ na dṛṣṭā niṣkṛti mayā ||
yathātmanaḥ priyāḥ prāṇāḥ sarveṣāṃ prāṇināṃ tathā ||

ta
smān mṛtyur bhayatrastā tavyāḥ prāṇino budhaiḥ ||
janmamṛtyur jarāduḥkhair nityaṃ saṃsārasāgare ||

yaṃtavaḥ
parikliśyaṃte mṛtyos traśyaṃni te dhikaṃ ||
yannimittaṃ bhavet chokas trāso cākrodhaś va ca ||

āyāso vā
yato mūlam ekāhām tat tyajet ||
mariṣyasīti yata duḥkhaṃ puruṣasyopajāyate ||

yuktaṃ tenānumā
nena paro pi parirakṣituṃ ||
yathā hi te jīvitam ātmānaḥ priyaṃ tathā pareṣām api jīvita priyaṃ ||

saṃrakṣase
jīvitam ātmano yathā tathā pareṣām api rakṣa jīvitaṃ ||
tasmā nāham imaṃ bhītam ayāṃpakṣa kapotakaṃ ||
yad atra yuktam anyasyāt_ mama syenāśu tad vadāṃ ||

āhārāt sarvabhūtāni saṃbhavaṃti jane
śvaraḥ
yitu ciraṃ
na tv āharavihīne ||
bhakṣād vilopitasyāsmān mama prāṇā viṃśāṃ pate ||

vihāya kāyaṃ yāsyaṃ¦
ti paṃthānam apunarbhavaṃ ||
mṛte ca mayi sarvaṃ me putradāra mariṣyati ||

rakṣamāṇaḥ kapotaṃ tvaṃ bahūn_ prāṇā ha
niṣyasi ||
dharmo yo cādhate dharmam anyaṃ sa na mataṃ sataṃ ||
avirodhī tu yo dharmaḥ sa dharmaḥ sadbhir ucyate ||
tasmād virodhe dharmasya saṃcitya gurulāghavaṃ ||
yachreyas tan mahīpāla kuru dharmavinirṇayaṃ ||
bahukalyāṇasaṃyuktaṃ bhāṣase vihagottamaḥ ||
suparṇapakṣarāṭa tvaṃ hi dharma eva na saṃśayaḥ ||

yayā hi
dharmasaṃyuktaṃ bahu||catraṃ bhāvase ||
na te aviditaṃ kiṃcid eti tvāṃ lakṣayāmy ahaṃ ||

nāto bhūyasta
ro dharmaḥ kaścid anyo smi ṣecaraḥ ||

prasahaśrasya gosahaśra prāṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ abhayaṃ jat pradī
yate ||
varam ekasya satvasya pradattābhayadakṣiṇā ||
na tu prasahaśrasya gosahaśram alaṃkṛtaṃ ||
abhayaṃ sarvabhūttebhyo yo dadāti dayāparaḥ ||
tasya dehād vimuktasya bhayaṃ vidate kvacit ||

hemadhe
nudharādīnāṃ dātāraḥ sulabhā bhuviḥ ||
durllabhaḥ puruṣo loke sarvabhūtadayāpradaḥ ||

mahatām api
jajñānāṃ kālena kṣīyate phalaṃ ||
bhītābhayapradanasya kṣaya eva na vidyate ||

dattam iṣṭaṃ tapaḥ taptaṃ tīrthaṃ
sevā śubhaṃ tathā ||
sarvāṇy abhayadanasya kalāṃ nārhaṃti ṣoḍaśīṃ ||

catuḥsāgaraparyaṃtāṃ yo dadyāt pṛthi
vīm imāṃ ||
abhayaṃ yaś ca bhūtebhyaḥs tayor abhayado dhikaḥ ||

api tyajed rājyam idaṃ śarīraṃ vā sudustya
jaṃ ||
na tv imaṃ bhayasaṃtrastaṃ ttrastaṃ tyakṣe dīnakapotakaṃ ||
yan mamāsti śubhaṃ kiṃcit tena janmani janmani ||
bhaveya mahatārttānāṃ prāṇināṃ ārttināśākaḥ ||
na hy ahaṃ kāmaye rājya na svargaṃ nāpunarbhavaṃ ||

prā
ṇināṃ bhayabhītānāṃ kāmaye bhayanāśanaṃ ||
jathā ca nānṛtā vāṇī mayaiṣā samudākṛtaḥ ||

satye
nānena bhagavān_ prasīdatu maheśvaraḥ ||
āhārārthe sadāraṃbhas tava cāyi vihaṃgama ||

tadā śreṣṭa
tavāhāram anyam eva dadāmi te ||
sa eva vihito smākaṃ dhātrā bhakṣyaḥ kapotakaḥ ||
tam evotsṛjyaṃ cahāraiḥ kāryyam asty aparair mama ||
śyenā kapotān_ pādaṃti śrutir eṣā sanātanī
mā rājan_ sāram ajñātvā kadalīskaṃdham āruhā ||

nāha sudhastramārgeṇa kvacid vartte
vihaṃgama ||
śāstrer evopadiṣṭo yaṃ dharmadhairyadayāparaiḥ ||
sarvasatveṣu ya dānam ekasatve ca yā dayā ||

sarvasatva
pradā tuḥ dayaikasmin viśiṣyate ||
sarve devā na tat kuryuḥ sarve yajñāś ca khecara ||

sarvatīrthabhivakaś ca ya
t kuryāt prāṇināṃ dayā ||
vāṅmanaḥkarttahār ye tu sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||

dayādamitapaṃthāno brahmalokaṃ
vrajaṃti te ||
gachatās tiṣṭhato vāpi jāgrataḥ svapito pi vā ||
yan na bhūtahitārthāya tat paśor iva ceṣṭitaṃ
jaṃgamāniva bhūtāni sthāvarāṇi ca ye narā ||
ātmavat parirakṣaṃti te yāṃti paramāṃ gatiṃ ||

prāṇi
nāṃ vadhyamānānāṃ yaḥ śaktaḥ samupekṣate ||
sa yāti narake ghore iti prāhur manīṣiṇaḥ ||

rājyaṃ śivā
nāṃ sumahat_ prayāchāmi tava dvija ||
yad vā kāmayase hy anyat_ kurjayitva kapotakaṃ ||
yadi rājan_ kapote te sudṛḍhā prītir īdṛśī ||
tataḥ kapotatulyāni svamāṃsāni prayacha me ||
anugraham imaṃ manye yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||
etat te haṃ prayachāmi svamāṃsaṃ yāvad ichasi ||
yad apriyaṃ tat sujanaś carād vadati vā na vā ||
mamātipriyam evaitat_ kasmād abhihitaṃ cirāt ||

a
dhruveṇa śarīreṇa pratikṣaṇadivāniśinā
dhruvaṃ yo nārjeyed dharmmaṃ sa socyo mūḍhacetanaḥ ||

yadi prāṇyupakā
rāya deho yaṃ nopayujyate ||
tataḥ kiṃm upacāro sya pratyahaṃ kṛyate vṛthā ||

nātiriktam ahaṃ yācaie
tava māṃsaṃ janeśvaraḥ ||
tasmāt_ kapotena dhṛtaṃ prayacha tulayā samaṃ ||

tad evāhaṃ kariṣyā
mi yan māṃ śyenābhiyācase ||
yenāsya rakṣaṇaṃ me syāt_ tadvat tava vihaṃgamā ||

evam u
ktā svamīṃsāni samutkatya sa pārthiva ||
prahṛṣṭas tolayāmāsa kapotena saha prabhuḥ ||

tyaktātmasuṣe bho
gechā sarvasatvasuṣaiṣinaḥ ||
bhavaṃti paraduḥkhena sādhavo nityaduḥkhitāḥ ||

dhriyamāṇas tu tulyā kapo
to vyatiricyate ||
punaś cotkṛtya māṃsāni tataḥ prādān mahīpati ||

na vidyate yadā māṃsaṃ kapotakasamaṃ
kvacit ||
tataḥ prakṣīṇamāṃso sau āruroha tulāṃ svayaṃ ||
paraduḥkhāturā nityaṃ sarvabhūtahite ratāḥ ||
nopekṣaṃte mahātmānaḥ svasukhāni mahāty api ||
atha tasmin_ samārūḍhe tulām ausīnare nṛpe ||

devaduṃdu
bhayo neduḥ puṣpavṛṣṭi papāta ha ||
tatas tasya tadā matvā dharmarājo dhṛtiṃ parāṃ ||

śākraḥ svarūpam āsthāya
vākyam etad abhaṣataḥ ||
idro ham asmi bhadraṃ te kapoto havyavāṭasvayaṃ ||

jijñāsamānau tvāṃ rājana imaṃ ya
jñam upāgatau ||
naitat pūrvaṃ nṛpāś cakrur na kariṣyaṃti cāpare ||
mahākāruṇyakeneha yat kṛtaṃ duḥkṛtaṃ nṛpa ||

pa
rārthi tyajataḥ prāṇāṃn_ yā prītir abhavat tava ||
prāṇisaṃprāyalubdheṣu na sā prāṇe dehināṃ ||

parārthaikātakalyā
ṇīṃ svaśreyātyaṃtaniṣṭurā ||
tvay eva kevalā rājan_ karuṇākaruṇāyate ||

rājasai sudṛḍhai vaṃddhaṃ tathā kṛtsnam i
daṃ jagat ||
tvaṃ jagadukhamokṣārthaṃ vaddhaḥ karuṇaya nṛpaḥ ||
tathā sarvātmānā vāpi doṣeṣv apahṛtaṃ tvayā ||

tathā
caivātmanāthāne vāsanāpi na vidyate ||
akṛterṣyaṃ ca vṛddheṣu hīnān anavamanya ca ||

akṛtvā sadṛśai sparddhā
tva lokottamatāṃ gataḥ ||
ātmaprāṇaiḥ paraprāṇān_ yo naraḥ parirakṣati ||

ye yāṃti paramaṃ dhāmayato na gacha
te punaḥ ||
prāṇair api tvayā rājan_ rakṣitaḥ kṛpaṇā janaḥ ||
patepakārajanmāno vidhātrā vihitā tu ye ||

saja
lā jaladāś caiva saphalā mahādrumāḥ ||
svamāṃsāny api dattāni dravyaṣv anyeṣu kā kathā ||

paśavo pi hi jīvaṃ
ti kevalāmodarabharā ||
sa punar jīvitaḥ śloghyo yaḥ parārthe sa jīvati ||

kim atra citraṃ yat saṃtaḥ parānu
grahatatparā ||
na hi svadehaśītāya yayaṃte caṃdanadrumā ||
paropakaraidhiyaḥ sukhāya gatanispṛhāḥ ||

jagaddhitāya
jāyaṃte sādhavas tv ādṛśā bhuvi ||
yat svamāṃsāni bhūtebhyaḥ samutkṛtāni pārthiva ||

eṣā te sāsvati kīrttir lo
kān anugamiṣyati ||
evam uktvā tu iṃdrāgni jagmatus triśālayaṃ ||
rāja tu dime dṛṣṭvā mumude devavac ciraṃ
ya idaṃ śṛṇuyān nityaṃ śiveś caritam uttamaṃ ||
sa vidhūyeha pāpāni prajāti tridivaṃ naraḥ

viciṃtya rājā sva
śariram adhruvaṃ dhruvaṃ yaśaḥ sarvajanasya durllabhaṃ ||

śarīradānāt parijīvarakṣaṇaṃ vidhāya lokatrayabhūṣaṇa
yayau || 83 ||

body.p: iti śrī itihāsasamuccaye írva iṃdrāgniṃ śaṃvāde caturtho dhyāyaḥ || 4 ||
